title: Next step after AI booking form launch

state.goal: Sell Zenno and get AI bookings flowing for Hamburg salons as fast as possible.
state.live: AI booking form on every shop page (get-found data, llms.txt, /ai-booking, keyless booking with safety caps). All live checks pass. No salon has switched AI booking on yet, so no real AI bookings can happen until owners turn it on.

options_context.announcement: A short message to existing salon owners: their page now shows up better in Google and AI search, and they can switch on AI booking in one tap. Directly drives adoption; without owners switching it on, the feature produces no bookings.
options_context.web_bot_auth: Cryptographic proof that a request really comes from ChatGPT/Google, giving verified agents higher limits and a trusted 'via ChatGPT' label. About half a day. Current conservative limits (30 bookings per salon per hour) are far above what any salon will see at launch.

next_step.instructions: Which should be done next to serve `state.goal`?

criteria.announcement: Draft and send the announcement to salon owners first.
criteria.web_bot_auth: Build Web Bot Auth verification first.
